## Acceptance Criteria

This feature is complete when:

- [ ] The requested behavior is implemented
- [ ] The feature works in the expected use case
- [ ] Edge cases are handled or clearly documented
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated, if needed
- [ ] A PR is opened and linked to this issue
